name: Obolisk
description: The Winterworks Obolisk in the vanilla Minecraft mob style: a block of obsidian that came alive, one 2 x 4 block pillar painted like stacked obsidian and crying-obsidian blocks at block resolution, with a grumpy carved face: a heavy slanted brow over two small flat glowing violet slit eyes, crying-obsidian tears and a frowning crack of a mouth. It walks by rocking from edge to edge and slams by toppling forward; in disguise its brow sinks shut and it is an obsidian pillar. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
author: lowpix example
